rows.abstract: \"The Sangguniang Kabataan Reform and Empowerment Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to grant the Katipunan ng mga Kabataan oversight powers to make SK officials accountable to their constituencies in the areas of local planning, budget and disbursement of funds.
